## Result and scope
Claimed negative resolution of the primary source's total-space positivity-preservation question for Naumann's defining equation (13), with an O_E(r) weight and probability-normalized fiber measures. The compact example uses E=O_{P¹}(1)⊕O_{P¹}(1), a smooth strictly positive initial metric on O_E(2)=O(2,2), and gives horizontal curvature exactly −1/96 at time (log 2)/2.

The catalogue's narrower flow-construction question was already answered in the source. This result concerns the source's actual positivity question, not the Griffiths conjecture. No novelty or historical-priority claim is made. Smooth finite-time existence over the family, from Naumann's Theorem 5, is an explicit analytic dependency.

## Normalization check
The defining scalar flow has reaction coefficient one. A separate scope note and the full independent audit show that a literal same-convention reading of the displayed r c term in equation (14) contradicts an elementary stationary positive product metric. They also explain the possible simultaneous root-metric/time scaling. No unsupported claim of a particular typo or authorial intention is made.

## Review and verification
- Full independent adversarial audit: PASS for the precise equation-(13) claim.
- Frozen proof SHA-256: 4deb64c3b249dcf26a87ccdd222bad837e61f107b5304ed0e3ad2c6f1e444b36.
- Frozen manifest SHA-256: 14e522b5bea40b8dc1c9a222d58048e4f667a4bc805df55dfb630d79b83a162c.
- Author verification: 40 symbolic identities and 441 supplementary exact rational points.
- Independent verification: 43 exact identities, all four charts, universal positivity bounds, stationary-product control, root/time rescaling, and frozen-file hashes; no grid used.
- All original frozen files and audit files are preserved; the publication manifest enumerates the delivered package. Source PDFs and full extracted texts are excluded.

## Changes
Adds only unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30003571/ and edits this target's QUEUE.md Status, Turns, and previously blank Findings cells. Status is claimed_solved at 3/5 substantive approaches. The complete candidate was obtained before the five-approach ceiling.

Draft for human review. No merge, release, or external outreach requested.
